name: base-blocked-unlock-pickup
task: Pick up the blocking ball and the key, in either order, unlock the door, and then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: R3, hard Existence(door_open), is redundant: R1 and R2 require blocker_moved and has_door_key before door_open, and R5 with hard Existence(target_picked_up) requires door_open. Remove R3; keep the stated prerequisites and order clauses.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the hard Existence(target_picked_up) and Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) already force door_open. The task says to unlock the door, but that step has no separate order clause requiring it to follow both picking up the blocking ball and acquiring the key. Add hard Precedence(blocker_moved, door_open) and Precedence(has_door_key, door_open); the existing clauses already include these, so no changes are needed.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: The clauses require the blocker and key before opening the door, then require picking up the box after opening it. The hard existence of the box with its precedence clause forces the door to open, and the two door precedence clauses force the blocker and key.

texts: Pick up the blocking ball and acquire the key, in either order, before opening the door.
Pick up the blocking ball and acquire the key, in either order, before opening the door.
Pick up the box after opening the door.
Open the door before picking up the box.
